heading: Definitions
lead: Notwithstanding section 2571 of this title, for purposes of this part—

tree.heading: NAFTA
tree.text: The term “NAFTA” means the North American Free Trade Agreement.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means any of the several States, the District of Columbia, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 96–39, title IV, § 481, as added Pub. L. 103–182, title III, § 351(a), Dec. 8, 1993, 107 Stat. 2122.)
